description: Elections Commission - M. A. M. Rahman of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Muslim Congress - M. A. D. Rathnasiri of the Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of Sri Lanka Freedom Party - P. U. Panawala of the Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of Sri Lanka Freedom Party
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific members of Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in their respective political parties. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government bodies, making it clearly fall under the Elections category (Type 7).
